decision.rule: pre-registered (cycle 22 L4), refusal first-class: A1 the axis must support 8 distinct octile edges; A2 |Pearson r| against every incumbent axis < 0.5; A3 at least 0.2 of same-3-axis-bin pairs must land in different animation octiles.
